## Covers in Streyn Mixes and Your Top Songs
- **Song covers show again:** the songs in "Your Top Songs" lists had no cover in their rows (the list only showed numbers). Every row now shows its cover like every other playlist: the real album cover for Spotify songs (looked up by the server if a song came without one), the video picture for YouTube songs, the cover of your own files
- **Mix and year covers in every theme:** in Green the drawn covers of the Streyn Mixes and top songs lists looked washed out (grey text, missing colour). They now look the same in every theme

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
